label: official-code checkpoint, explicitly scoped real-float32 verification semantics

supersedes.reason: r2 incorrectly required the real-float32 B3 program to have identical labels to the released literal-fp16-plus-autocast evaluation program; r3 treats their observed differences as artifact-identity evidence and verifies the explicitly scoped B3 graph

endpoint.identity: independently audited ordered official PGD-50 endpoint artifact

selection.policy: first 1000 ordered inputs; no correctness or route filtering

semantics.reference: official checkpoint modules in eval mode under the B3 real-float32 program
semantics.route_a: unit-pixel input, real-affine normalization, folded affine router, fixed expert specialization
semantics.consumer: auto_LiRPA BoundedModule concrete forward in the pinned alpha-beta-CROWN environment
semantics.dispatch_batch_shape: one input per expert call, matching released MOE_Resnet18.forward
semantics.literal_runtime_comparison: the released B1 float16 preprocessing plus autocast labels are reported but are not silently equated with the explicitly scoped real-float32 B3 program
semantics.tie: route mismatch is waived only when either compared score vector has top1-top2 margin <= tie_tolerance

claim_scope: Semantic conformance of the explicitly identified B3 real-float32 program only. The literal B1 runtime is a distinct measured artifact. This stage is not a robustness certificate, accuracy experiment, or CROWN coverage result.
